prompt: How many successfully predicted asteroid impacts have resulted in the recovery of meteorites in the last five years?
answer: 2. The IAU reports that the last two of the four successfully predicted impacts in 2021–2024 resulted in meteorite recoveries: 2023 CX1 and 2024 BX1.
